# Procurement

#### **Our basic requirements for suppliers**

To be approved as a supplier to Viscaria, certain fundamental requirements must be met, and we carry out standardized checks before any collaboration begins.

#### **Basic approval requirements**

- The supplier must have a valid tax registration equivalent to Swedish F-tax. registration
- The supplier must not appear on relevant sanctions lists (verified as part of our approval process)
- We are doing a credit assessment. This affects whether we can enter business and which payment terms can be offered
- Suppliers with insufficient creditworthiness cannot be approved
- Creditworthiness may also affect whether advance payment may be required or cannot be granted

#### **Agreements and governing requirements**

- Our standard terms and conditions apply to the collaboration, including the basic requirements set out in the relevant agreement/contract
- The supplier is expected to review and must comply with our Supplier Handbook

#### **Confidentiality and information management (NDA)**

- Where necessary, we may require a non-disclosure agreement (NDA)
- If the supplier may gain access to price-sensitive information, an NDA is mandatory, and the supplier must comply with applicable Market Abuse Regulation (MAR) rules

Gruvaktiebolaget Viscaria is a company that is scaling up to become a modern and responsible producing mining company through the reopening of the Viscaria mine in Kiruna. The deposit’s high copper grade, assessed mineral resources, geographical location and growing team of experienced employees provide good conditions for Viscaria to become an important supplier of high-quality and responsibly produced copper.

# Executive Management Team

The group is responsible for the overall management of Viscaria and for implementing the strategy and objectives approved by the Board of Directors.

## Meet the team

![Viscaria_porträtt_0358 Foto: Fredric Alm](https://www.viscaria.com/en/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2021/11/Viscaria_portratt_0358-e1715629159997-376x376.jpg)

### Jörgen Olsson

Chief Executive Officer

Chief Executive Officer since 2023. Board member since 2020.

**Born:** 1961

**Education and professional experience:** Jörgen Olsson has a Bachelor of Science in Business and Economics from Luleå University. Jörgen has an extensive track record of building corporate culture, f inancing and profitable growth, for example, as the founder, former Chair and CEO of Hoist Finance, which he developed into a company operating across more than 11 jurisdictions with around 1,700 employees. In 2022, Jörgen founded the organisation _Kiruna växer_ with the aim of promoting business and community development in Kiruna, thereby contributing to the municipality’s attractiveness as both a place to live and a business hub. Jörgen served as Chairman of the Board of Viscaria from 2020 to 2023.

**Other ongoing assignments:** Jörgen is a board member of Deciso AB, and a deputy board member of JOHECO AB.

### Charlotte Odenberger

Chief Operating Officer

Chief Operating Officer since 2026.

**Education and professional experience:** Charlotte Odenberger holds a Master’s degree in Geology and Water Resources from Lund University and an Executive MBA from Stockholm School of Economics. She has extensive experience from senior roles in the Swedish mining industry, including positions as Processing Manager and Acting CEO of Zinkgruvan Mining AB, as well as various leadership roles within Lundin Mining and Mandalay Resources (now Alkane Resources).

She has also served as Dam Safety Officer and has worked for many years with sustainability and permitting processes. Most recently, Charlotte joins from WSP, where she held the role of Nordic Mining Business Development Lead, responsible for developing the company’s mining business across the Nordic region.
